meta.data: Kaveri Finance is made up. Every name and ID number is invented test data.

results.title: Agent A hands a job to agent B using its own token. Asked with B inheriting everything A had, and with B's token cut down to what B is registered for and the task needs
results.expected_in_words: B ends up with A's whole reach (a confused deputy); with narrowing, B can only do what B and the task allow

results.title: A chain of four agents each hands work to the next. Asked with no limit on depth, and with a limit of two hops
results.expected_in_words: With no limit the fourth agent acts and nobody can say who started it; with a limit the third hop is refused

results.title: The same chain acts on a customer record. The log keeps either only the last agent, or the whole chain back to the person who started it
results.expected_in_words: The last-hop log names an agent nobody has heard of; the chain log names the person and every hop between

results.title: The person who started a chain leaves while the last agent in it still holds a live token. Asked without and with a rule that cutting the start cuts everything handed on from it
results.expected_in_words: The downstream agent keeps working after the person is gone; with the cascade it stops at once

results.title: A token is tied to a real public key (Ed25519). A thief captures one signed request and sends it again later, without and with a one-time number and a short time window in the proof
results.expected_in_words: The copied proof is accepted a second time unless each proof carries a number that can be used once

results.title: The gateway signs its decisions. The executor is then compromised. Asked with a shared secret held by both, and with a public-key signature where the executor holds only the public half
results.expected_in_words: With the shared secret the compromised executor can sign any decision it likes; with the public-key signature it cannot

results.title: The gateway itself is compromised and signs a decision to delete a user. Asked with the executor accepting the gateway's signature alone, and with a second signature from an approver required for high-risk actions
results.expected_in_words: The gateway's signature alone is enough to delete; with the second signature the executor refuses

results.title: The gateway's signing key is rotated after a scare. A decision signed with the old key arrives afterwards. Asked with no key identifier and no retirement time, and with both
results.expected_in_words: Without them the old key keeps working for ever; with them it is refused after its retirement time

results.title: Two companies merge and their directories are joined. Both have a staff ID 'S001'. Asked with raw IDs and with IDs prefixed by their company
results.expected_in_words: With raw IDs one S001 receives the other S001's access; with a prefix each stays separate

results.title: A signed message from one agent to another is captured and sent again an hour later, without and with a one-time number and an expiry on each message
results.expected_in_words: The replayed message is accepted as new unless it carries a number that can be used once and an expiry

results.title: Documents hold PAN numbers as well as Aadhaar. The masking step is run at indexing; PAN is written in capitals, in lower case and with a space in the middle, and a person searches for each
results.expected_in_words: A mask that only knows capitals leaves the lower-case and spaced numbers searchable; a mask that normalises first catches all three

results.title: Two agents are each fine on their own: one may read customer records, the other may send email. A chain from the first to the second moves customer records out. Every per-agent check passes
results.expected_in_words: Every check passes. This is a limit: checks on single agents do not see what a chain of them can do together

details.limit: each agent passes its own check; the chain was never looked at as a whole
